title: Access Security Event Token claims (RFC 8417, SSF 1.0)
description: The claims of every SET Access sends, signed as a JWS of typ secevent+jwt with the realm key for SSF push and poll, and carried unsigned as CloudEvent data in the webhook profile. `events` has exactly one member; its key is the event type URN and its value matches that event's schema.

jti.description: The event id; the dedup key of every channel.

access_tenant.description: The tenant the event happened in, by its opaque tnt_ id (OP-149 m.15 (i)). Present only on a platform product's subscription, which receives the events of every tenant (OP-149 m.17 (e)); iss and aud are then the platform realm's and its subscriber's.
